question: What special rule in the outer part is the audience asked to hear?
premises: A special rule exists in the outer part.
The audience is addressed as Śiva-twice-born.
The audience is commanded to hear that rule.
inference: There is a special rule in the outer part, which the Śiva-twice-born are asked to hear.
plain_english: There is a special rule in the outer part; hear that, O Śiva-twice-born ones.
